sources.name: Court Pace Index database (courtspeed.com)
sources.detail: Court Pace Index readings 2012-2026 for the Grand Slams, Masters 1000s and ATP Finals, compiled from ATP / Tennis TV broadcast data. Centre-court readings; no altitude adjustment.

sources.name: Tennis Abstract ATP Surface Speed Ratings
sources.detail: Ace rate per event adjusted for the servers and returners in each match, centred on 1.00 for a tour-average surface. Last update 2026-11-02.

sources.name: Computed history - from Jeff Sackmann's ATP archive
sources.detail: Seasons before 2026 are recomputed here from the public ATP match archive compiled by Jeff Sackmann (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0), using the published method: ace rate adjusted for the server and returner in every match, normalised so a tour-average event reads 1.00. Reproduces the published 2026 figures with r = 0.93 and a mean absolute difference of 0.10. Non-commercial use only.
